definitions.name: Rivet Lance
definitions.text: A steady strike. A useful spine for a growing board.

definitions.name: Folding Buckler
definitions.text: Build Shield before the next blow lands.

definitions.name: Ember Kettle
definitions.text: Apply Burn. Burn ticks every half second and decays.

definitions.name: Bitter Vial
definitions.text: Two doses. The timer continues filling when the vial is empty.

definitions.name: Spring Magazine
definitions.text: Fully reload the item immediately to its left.

definitions.name: Paced Courier
definitions.text: Haste adjacent cooldown items for 1.8 seconds.

definitions.name: Winter Fan
definitions.text: Freeze one random small or medium enemy cooldown item.

definitions.name: Tar Roller
definitions.text: Slow a random enemy timer. Prefer one that is not already Slowed.

definitions.name: Minute Hand
definitions.text: Charge the item to its right by 0.95 seconds.

definitions.name: Tea Tray
definitions.text: Heal and gain Regen. Ordinary healing also partially cleanses.

definitions.name: Moss Jar
definitions.text: At combat start, gain Regen.

definitions.name: Echo Anvil
definitions.text: Two separate casts. Each rolls one shared crit for its Damage and Shield.

definitions.name: Velvet Leech
definitions.text: Heal for Shield and Health damage dealt. Lifesteal does not cleanse.

definitions.name: Kite Engine
definitions.text: Starts Flying. Incoming Slow and Freeze durations are halved.

definitions.name: Scrap Magnet
definitions.text: Disable the eligible enemy cooldown item with the lowest sell value.

definitions.name: Patch Drone
definitions.text: Repair the first destroyed ally, then gain Shield.

definitions.name: Clearwater Flask
definitions.text: Cleanse half of Burn and Poison, then Heal.

definitions.name: Copper Ledger
definitions.text: From board or stash: gain 2 gold on merchant visits and permanently gain 1 sell value on purchases.

definitions.name: Survey Kit
definitions.text: Quest: buy 3 Tools. Permanently give all owned Weapons +7 Damage.

definitions.name: Warm Coil
definitions.text: When you apply Burn, Charge this by 0.45 seconds (0.5 second internal cooldown).

definitions.name: Pocket Workbench
definitions.text: While on board, adjacent Weapons have +8 Damage.

definitions.name: Prism Box
definitions.text: Transform one other small ally into a random same-size item for this fight.

definitions.name: Tuning Pin
definitions.text: Reduce the longest allied cooldown by 0.18 seconds for the fight.

definitions.name: Second Bell
definitions.text: Every fifth other allied item use: force that item to cast. Twice per fight.

definitions.name: Rain Stitch
definitions.text: Gain Shield and give the right neighbor the Aquatic type for the fight.

definitions.name: Lift Ribbon
definitions.text: Make the other ally with the most Damage Flying.

definitions.name: Sand Hourglass
definitions.text: Deal Damage and bring the storm forward.

definitions.name: Return Token
definitions.text: The first time you would die each fight, Heal 55 before death is committed.

definitions.name: Sealed Star
definitions.text: A rare terminal-tier relic.

definitions.name: Opening Cushion
definitions.text: Start combat with 20 Shield.

definitions.name: Cinder Memory
definitions.text: Every third allied use applies 2 Burn.

definitions.name: Careful Hands
definitions.text: Once each second, gaining Shield Charges the leftmost Weapon by 0.25 seconds.

definitions.name: Spare Change
definitions.text: Gain 1 gold at each hour completion.

definitions.name: Steady Aim
definitions.text: Your Weapons have +15% crit chance.

definitions.name: Soothing Hum
definitions.text: After applying Poison, Heal 4. At most once per second.

definitions.name: Field Notes
definitions.text: The first two purchases each day grant 1 XP.

definitions.name: Weather Eye
definitions.text: At half Health, cleanse all Burn and Poison once per fight.

encounters.name: The Open Stalls
encounters.text: A broad selection from the evening market.

encounters.name: The Tool Cart
encounters.text: Tools for surprising neighbors. Tools cost 1 less.

encounters.name: A Quiet Table
encounters.text: Rest, study, or improve your trade.

encounters.name: The Patient Artisan

rewards.label: Reimagine
rewards.text: Transform one item into another of the same size and tier.

encounters.text: Improve a familiar object or take payment.

encounters.name: Night School
encounters.text: Choose a passive skill. Skills occupy no board space.

encounters.name: The Rain Altar

rewards.label: Venom
rewards.text: Add Poison to an active item.

encounters.text: Choose an enchantment for a compatible item.

encounters.name: An Unclaimed Crate
encounters.text: Choose a small item or sell the crate.

starts.label: A stall of your own
starts.text: +11 gold and +2 income. Includes a Rivet Lance.

starts.label: A warm little secret
starts.text: A cinder-enchanted Folding Buckler and a Rivet Lance.

starts.label: Learn the evening rhythm
starts.text: Cinder Memory, a Rivet Lance, and +20 maximum Health.
